scope: Source-bound CPU whole-domain GELU64 component collector; no implicit healthy timeout.

phases.label: fixed public profile, P coverage, slots and oracle preflight passed

limitations: One fixed synthetic full-slot GELU fixture with endpoint/interior probes and zero padding; no native FFN or complete block.
Client and keyless server are separate objects in one dedicated process; not a three-process file boundary or OS sandbox.
All seven client codec APIs are blocked through the genuine noncanonical prestage and all nine checkpoints; no early decode.
The exact layer0 v2 degree64 balanced GELU is used; no refresh or rotation keys are required.
T64 boundary amplification is covered only if the unchanged1e-6 all-slot gate passes.
Raw key payload and phase RSS observations are not a peak device memory or scoring calibration claim.

plan.physical_padding: P(0), not zero; following dense source mask required

limitations: No refresh or rotation keys; one supplied relinearization pair. Raw key sizes exclude tables/executables/retained ciphertexts and are not peak memory.
Synthetic whole-domain probes and P(0) padding only; no native FFN, residual, LayerNorm, complete block or full model.
